summary: Shared inbox help desk and knowledge base for customer support teams.
access_note: API access is on Standard, Plus and Pro; a 15-day trial of Standard or Plus is available. OAuth2 app created under Your Profile > My apps.
blocker_note: API requires a paid plan (a free plan exists but lacks API access); the official MCP is read-only.
notes: Mailbox API 2.0 docs page is gzip-served and the Docs API uses a separate API key (not covered here). Pricing table was read to see API access row: first plan column Free appears to omit it, but the row text did not map columns cleanly.

evidence.quote: This is an HTTPS-only API and it uses OAuth 2.0 authorization , implementing Authorization Code and Client Credential flows.
This integration is available on the Standard, Plus, and Pro plans — any plan that includes Help Scout API access.
All requests have to be authenticated via the Authorization header
Set the remote MCP server URL to https://mcp.helpscout.net/mcp .
